Welcome to Test Garden Supply

Test Garden Supply is a made-up shop used to test the site audit kit. It sells seeds, soil, pots and simple tools for small gardens. Every page here has enough plain words for the crawler to treat it as a real page with real content. The shop opens on weekdays and answers questions about planting times, watering and light. Customers can read guides, compare products and ask for help by email.
